Samira (People Ops): Quick operational update for this review cycle: new manager sign-off checklist + timezone-friendly slots + reviewer blackout days. Please read and update your tracker.
Theo (Manager): Where's the tracker?
Samira (People Ops): Tracker + slot picker: https://rwd.co/review-signoff-2287. Use the timezone dropdown so we can offer AM/PM windows across regions.
Pri (Manager): What's in the sign-off checklist?
Samira (People Ops): Short checklist snippet to paste into the manager comments box:
```
Manager sign-off checklist:
- Completed written feedback (2 bullets min)
- Peer excerpts attached (2 max)
- Calibration note (1 line): evidence -> rubric -> recommendation
- Conflict flags (Y/N)
- Promotion checkbox (Y/N) + 1-paragraph growth plan if nominated
```
Alex (Eng): Blackout days? We have a product launch week overlapping reviews.
Samira (People Ops): We added optional reviewer blackout days in the tracker. If you mark blackout, People Ops will avoid scheduling you for live syncs during those days and will assign a floater instead. Please only use blackout for critical PTO or launch commitments.
Theo (Manager): Any changes to reminders cadence? My team gets a lot of emails.
Samira (People Ops): Reminders are now consolidated: 3 total pings from SignoffBot — 7 days, 48 hours, and 6 hours before your final submit deadline. If you need more nudges, opt into daily morning reminders in the tracker.
SignoffBot: Reminder: sign-off tracker created for 2287 cycle. Fill your timezone and blackout days to get appropriate slots. :robot_face:
Pri (Manager): For audit purposes, can we export the form history? Finance sometimes asks for a PDF package.
Samira (People Ops): Yes. After calibration closes, People Ops will generate an audit bundle (zip) per org with: final signed forms, calibration notes, and promotion docs. Request via the audit-request form in #docs and allow 48h processing.
Alex (Eng): If a manager needs to hand off last-minute, what's the minimal handoff?
Samira (People Ops): Minimal handoff = draft feedback + two peer quotes + one-line open question. Paste into the backfill column. People Ops will send a DM template to the new reviewer.
Theo (Manager): Is there a preservation policy for recordings and notes?
Samira (People Ops): Data retention rules: calibration recordings = 45 days (auto-delete), sign-off tracker snapshots = 1 year (archived), audit exports kept per request lifecycle. Sensitive recordings must be org-internal only.
Pri (Manager): Contractors and promos?
Samira (People Ops): Contractors follow same sign-off flow but use the "contractor" checkbox. Conversion/Promo requests need the growth paragraph + finance OK before final sign-off.
SignoffBot: Scheduled: consolidated reminders will run for participants who have a timezone set. Update your timezone in the tracker to avoid missed pings. :bell:
Alex (Eng): Thanks  updating now.
Theo (Manager): Appreciate the clarity. Will brief my leads this afternoon.
Samira (People Ops): Thanks all  we'll post the 1-page manager quick guide and the sign-off DM templates in #docs within the hour. Ping @people-ops for urgent swaps.
